Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have histopathological confirmation of Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC) by the Laboratory of Pathology of the National Cancer Institute (NCI) prior to entering this study. Or histopathological confirmation of carcinoma in the setting of clinical and radiological characteristics which, together with the pathology, are highly suggestive of a diagnosis of HCC.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has histopathological confirmation of metastatic breast carcinoma, not HCC.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have disease that is not amenable to potentially curative resection or ablative techniques. In addition, disease must not be amenable to transhepatic arterial chemoembolization (TACE). Patients may have had prior TACE and had disease progression following it. Patients must not be considered potential candidates for liver transplantation. This determination will be made after hepatobiliary surgical input at the NCI multidisciplinary conference.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's condition is metastatic breast cancer, not HCC, making this criterion irrelevant.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: All patients enrolled will be required to have measurable disease.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has metastatic breast cancer with measurable liver lesions, meeting this criterion.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: If liver cirrhosis is present, patient must have a Child-Pugh A classification.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's condition is metastatic breast cancer, not HCC, making this criterion irrelevant.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have progressed on or been intolerant of prior sorafenib therapy.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's treatment history does not mention sorafenib, making this criterion irrelevant.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must with cirrhosis have had esophagogastric endoscopy within the previous 6 months prior to study entry for the assessment of varices. If the patient has not had this done they must be willing to undergo this procedure prior to study entry.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's condition is metastatic breast cancer, not HCC, making this criterion irrelevant.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have normal organ and marrow function as defined below: - Absolute neutrophil count greater than or equal to 1,500/mcL - Platelets greater than or equal to 60,000/mcL - Total bilirubin less than or equal to 3 times upper normal limits - Aspartate aminotransferase (AST)/alanine aminotransferase (ALT) less than or equal to 10 times upper limit of normal - Creatinine less than or equal to 1.5 times upper normal limits OR creatinine clearance greater than or equal to 40 mL/min/1.73 m^2 for patients with creatinine levels above institutional normal, as calculated by the Cockcroft Gault formula.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's organ and marrow function data are not provided.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have recovered from any acute toxicity related to prior therapy, including surgery. Toxicity should be less than or equal to grade 1 or returned to baseline.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's recovery from acute toxicity.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must not have other invasive malignancies within the past 3 years (with the exception of non-melanoma skin cancers, carcinoma in situ of the cervix and noninvasive bladder cancer).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a history of breast cancer, which is not within the past 3 years, meeting this criterion.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Enrolled patients must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) prior to study entry, the duration of study participation and 3 months after the end of the treatment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patient must be able to understand and willing to sign a written informed consent document.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with known brain metastases will be excluded from this clinical trial because of their poor prognosis and because they often develop progressive neurologic dysfunction that would confound the evaluation of neurologic and other adverse events.
